Every arc between vertices is a multiple of 40 deg: '40(k+m)=180 => k+m=4.5', impossible 'whether minor or major'. At a shared vertex the inscribed angle is half an arc, so a 180-deg arc is needed, also impossible. The solver keeps doubting this ('implies at least one') but re-checks the theorem, finds no flaw, and the write-up gives this argument. Python: none of the 69 meeting pairs is perpendicular, and no two chords of a regular 9-gon are.
